codePatterns: Use axios interceptors to unwrap backend response format
LocalStorage fallback pattern for offline-first widgets
Spring physics: transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 20 }}
Layout animations: add layout prop to motion components
Enter/exit: wrap with AnimatePresence, use initial/animate/exit props
Modal input styling: bg-white/[0.06] border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-3
Focus states: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-400/50 focus:border-amber-400/50
Form button layout: flex justify-end gap-3 with Cancel (secondary) + Submit (primary)
React Portal: Use createPortal(content, document.body) for modals to avoid transform issues
Debounced search: useEffect with setTimeout(300ms) for API calls

namingConventions.components: PascalCase with Widget suffix for dashboard widgets

projectSpecificRules: Backend wraps responses in { data, success } format
Use better-sqlite3 synchronous API for simplicity
Vite proxy forwards /api to backend port
Dark amber accent colors (#b45309, #d97706) with black text for contrast
Noir palette for backgrounds (noir-950 to noir-500)
Outfit font for headings, DM Sans for body text
